
 Usage: houston prune [OPTIONS]

 Delete every `down` repro — INCLUDING its data volume and record. Skips pinned and running ones.

╭─ Options ──╮
 --yes      -y        skip the confirmation prompt (for scripts/CI)
 --orphans            also delete Kubernetes namespaces houston owns that no local record
                      explains
 --force              with --orphans, sweep namespaces that belong to somebody else or whose
                      owner cannot be read
 --help               Show this message and exit.
╰──╯
